name: Complementary transaction
oneLine: A reply that answers from the exact ego state the stimulus addressed - keeps the vectors parallel and lets the exchange continue indefinitely.
whatYouDid: Every time you reassured Rohit from Nurturing Parent, he came back from Adapted Child with another small question - the chain kept going because it was complementary, not because it was helping him.
confusion: People assume complementary means healthy; the tell is that a Parent-Child loop is just as complementary as an Adult-Adult one - rule 1 only predicts that it continues, not that it's good for anyone in it.

fromBook.quote: So long as transactions remain complementary, communication can continue indefinitely.

expand.definition: A complementary transaction is one in which the transactional vectors are parallel and the ego-state addressed is the one that responds - also called a parallel transaction.
expand.otherFraming: TA Today points out the rule says "can continue", not "will continue" - complementary transactions don't force a conversation to go on forever, they just remove anything in the process of communication that would break the flow.
expand.tryThisToday: Pick a loop you're in with someone that never seems to end, and check whether every reply has been answering the exact state it was addressed in - that's rule 1 at work, independent of whether the loop is doing either of you any good.
